data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 清晨河岸
data.description: 天刚亮，她沿河跑到桥下放慢脚步，低头看了一眼计时表。
data.action: slowing to a walk and checking a wristwatch
data.promptProse: Slowing her jog to a measured walk along a misty riverside gravel path at sunrise, Bazett checks her digital chronograph watch to log her lap time. The rising sun casts a brilliant golden reflection across the moving river water, illuminating weeping willow silhouettes, morning dew on the grass, and her breath misting in the crisp morning air.
